english.note: Use this when focusing on the person-oriented habit of judging or looking down on others by status.

examples.english: Pretending not to see poor people is such snobbery; it is really hard to stand.
examples.traditional: 見到窮人就扮睇唔到，呢種勢利眼真係好難頂。
